name: sankey-chart
title: Sankey chart
description: A flow diagram: node bars in columns joined by ribbons whose thickness is proportional to the flow they carry. Neutral by default with optional per-node color, it fills the host's box on both axes, lays out any number of stages via longest-path columns, and makes every ribbon a keyboard-focusable button with hover emphasis and host-controllable link selection drawn as a centerline stroke.
